claim_scope: counterfactual action-distance validation only; not closed-loop SR

confidence_gate.warning: small source calibration set; log confidence and abstentions

confidence_gate.update_type: source-oof residual novelty multiplied by nearest-source-context support
confidence_gate.application_type: current-observation source residual novelty only; context support is update-only
confidence_gate.update_semantics: only observations above the source-OOF calibration confidence maximum update episode EMA; rejected observations hold last accepted estimate
confidence_gate.interpretation: source-only update-abstention heuristic; appearance estimate is held across later OOD contexts
confidence_gate.application_semantics: the held correction is scaled per observation by residual_confidence without reusing the context-support term

information_budget.source_baseline: source development Clean features and observable proprioception only
information_budget.target_estimators: target Shift observations/history and proprioception only
information_budget.oracle_clean_replacement: privileged same-state Clean observation; upper-bound diagnostic
information_budget.clean_residuals: offline negative control only; never fed to target estimators

environment_protocol.executed_action_conversion: normalizer.unnormalize_action then clip to controller range
